[190] 3 hours = 180 minutes. 180 minutes * 2 peaches/minute = 360 peaches.

[191] 10 ducks * 3.5 pounds/duck/week = 35 pounds/week for the flock. 35 pounds / 7 days = 5 pounds/day.

[192] Net change per year = 10 (planted) - 2 (chopped) = 8 trees. After 10 years, trees = 50 + (8 * 10) = 130. 30% of 130 die = 0.3 * 130 = 39. Trees remaining = 130 - 39 = 91.

[193] Friday: 18 pink. Saturday: 1/3 of 18 = 6 are painted white and returned. So, 18 - 6 = 12 pink + 6 white. Sunday: add 18 pink. Total: (12 + 18) pink and 6 white = 30 pink and 6 white. Difference: 30 - 6 = 24.

[194] 5 colors * $2/color = $10. Change = $20 - $10 = $10.

[195] Pen = $1.20 + $0.30 = $1.50. 8 pens = 8 * $1.50 = $12.00.

[196] Total carrots used = 40 restaurants * 2 pounds = 80 pounds. Remaining = 200 - 80 = 120 pounds.

[197] Kids = Total - Men - Women = 23786 - 8417 - 9092 = 6277.

[198] Initial: 20. Month 1: 3 * 20 = 60. Month 2: 60 - 20 = 40. Month 3: 2 * (60 + 40) = 2 * 100 = 200. Total = 20 + 60 + 40 + 200 = 320.

[199] 1000 sentences / 2 = 500 sentences per publisher. Rate A = 5 cents. Rate B = 10 cents. Total = (500 * 5) + (500 * 10) = 2500 + 5000 = 7500 cents.
